messages:
miriam: Heads-up: billing console showed a weird provisional delta after a canary where we downgraded model mid-stream. customer 312 saw provisional go +28 then a reconcile -50 -> net -22.
liam: Model downgrade mid-request? that's new. any traces?
miriam: yes. canary canary-2025-11, region us-east primary ran out of capacity so router swapped to gpt-small mid-stream; toolcall had started before swap. logs attached.
cheng: pasting relevant snippet (sanitized):
router.INFO: session=ses_0YxQ route=us-east -> fallback=us-west model_swap=gpt-large->gpt-small reconnect=true
ledger.DEBUG: session=ses_0YxQ provisional+28 toolcall=tc_77 truncated=true
ledger.DEBUG: session=ses_0YxQ confirm+28 toolcall=tc_77 reason=toolcall-complete
ledger.DEBUG: session=ses_0YxQ reconcile_adjust=-50 reason=duplicate-confirmation
ui.DEBUG: provisional_before=+28 provisional_after=-22
miriam: So timeline looks like: provisional applied on partial toolcall, router swapped and reissued toolcall on smaller model (different token estimate), ledger later confirmed both and then tried to dedupe resulting in a bigger negative adjust.
liam: That reconcile -50 implies confirmed total was treated as two distinct confirmations sum(28 + 50) then we dedup leaving -22. We should not let reconcile make UI negative. server/API should clamp.
avery: (cc avery) can console show "correction" instead of negative? Also we should show both provisional and final reconciliation events in timeline.
avery: agree. minimal UX: clamp number to 0, show banner "Billing corrections applied during routing/model swap" with link to audit events.
cheng: root cause likely router not preserving toolcall idempotency across model swap. fallback path creates a new toolcall id and different token estimate for small model, so ledger sees two confirmed charges. need to propagate original toolcall id or mark swap as single logical toolcall.
liam: Ledger side: we'll add a reconcile policy: when reconcile_adjust would make provisional < 0, emit an audit event and clamp API value to 0; also record reconcile_reason=multi-confirmation. I'll open PR.
miriam: SRE: can you reproduce with staging? steps: 1) enable canary model-swap on low capacity, 2) start stream with toolcall, 3) force model swap mid-stream, 4) let toolcall complete on both paths.
sre-bot: Repro ticket created PLAT-3698. runbook: simulate packet loss to force reconnect then inject capacity drain to trigger model swap.
cheng: I'll update router to forward X-Toolcall-Idempotency and also add a swap-marker header when swapping models so ledger can treat them as same logical toolcall. ETA: tomorrow AM for unit tests + canary.
avery: UI ETA 4h for clamp + banner, will rely on ledger audit field to populate banner link.
liam: Hotfix: server-side clamp pushed to canary in 1h; will also emit metric billing.reconcile.multi_confirm occurrences.
miriam: owners: liam (ledger), cheng (router), avery (console), miriam (reporter/SRE).
sre-bot: Canary paused: canary-2025-11 paused at 2025-11-03T16:20Z pending fixes.
miriam: OK closing thread; followups in PLAT-3698 and PRs. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
